article.headline: Fitzpatrick's 32 lead New Haven over Fairleigh Dickinson 84-77
article.description: — Jabri Fitzpatrick's 32 points led New Haven over Fairleigh Dickinson 84-77 on Saturday.
article.linkText: Fitzpatrick's 32 lead New Haven over Fairleigh Dickinson 84-77

categories.description: New Haven Chargers @ Fairleigh Dickinson Knights

event.description: New Haven Chargers @ Fairleigh Dickinson Knights

keywords: New Haven Chargers @ Fairleigh Dickinson Knights
article.story: TEANECK, N.J. -- — Jabri Fitzpatrick's 32 points led New Haven over Fairleigh Dickinson 84-77 on Saturday. Fitzpatrick added five rebounds and three steals for the Chargers (13-15, 8-7 Northeast Conference). Kheni Briggs scored 18 points, shooting 7 for 11, including 4 for 7 from beyond the arc. Andre Pasha shot 5 for 8 (3 for 5 from 3-point range) and 3 of 3 from the free-throw line to finish with 16 points. Joey Niesman led the way for the Knights (11-18, 8-8) with 24 points and two steals. Fairleigh Dickinson also got 14 points from Cyril Martynov. Eric Parnell finished with 10 points. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
